pages.title: Sika Deer
pages.text: The sika deer ($(o)Cervus nippon$()) is a medium-sized deer native to East Asia, from Japan and Taiwan to eastern China and the Russian Far East.$(br2)Its chestnut summer coat is marked with white spots, which fade as it grows a darker winter coat.$(br2)Sika deer are highly vocal, using a wide range of calls including whistles and screams, and they have been introduced to Europe, North America and New Zealand.
